name: Prazosin
summary: Prazosin Hydrochloride, commonly referred to as simply prazosin, and sold under various brand names, is an alpha-adrenergic receptor blocking agent (α1 blocker) medication. Prazosin is most commonly used to lower high blood pressure, or to treat symptoms of an enlarged prostate. Prazosin is also often used as an off-label medication, as a nightmare preventative for those with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).

pharmacology.text: Prazosin is an α1-blocker that acts as a non-selective inverse agonist at α1-adrenergic receptors, including of the α1A-, α1B-, and α1D-adrenergic receptor subtypes. It binds to these receptors with affinity (Ki) values of 0.13 to 1.0 nM for the α1Α-adrenergic receptor, 0.06 to 0.62 nM for the α1B-adrenergic receptor, and 0.06 to 0.38 nM for the α1D-adrenergic receptor.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include dizziness, sleepiness, nausea, and heart palpitations. Serious side effects may include low blood pressure with standing and depression.
